programs.name: Smart Classrooms & ICT Lab
programs.description: Interactive digital boards in every section of Classes VI–X and a 20-seat computer lab set up under PM SHRI. Students learn typing, spreadsheets and basic coding from Class VII.

programs.name: Eco Club & Kitchen Garden
programs.description: Students grow leafy vegetables for the mid-day meal, run a compost pit, and planted 400 saplings on campus and along the Arutla road during Vana Mahotsav.

programs.name: Annual Sports Meet
programs.description: Kabaddi, kho-kho, volleyball and athletics across four houses. Winners go on to the Manchal mandal and Ranga Reddy district meets.

programs.name: Science Fair & Tinkering
programs.description: Working models built by Classes VIII–X, judged by teachers from neighbouring schools. The best three are sent to the district Bal Vaigyanik Pradarshini.

programs.name: School Health Programme
programs.description: Health, eye and dental check-ups with PHC Manchal under Rashtriya Bal Swasthya Karyakram, plus weekly iron-folic acid supplementation.

programs.name: Bathukamma & Culture Week
programs.description: Students and mothers build Bathukamma together on campus, followed by a week of folk song, dance and Telugu elocution.

programs.name: Spoken English Club
programs.description: Conversation circles, storytelling and debates in English for Telugu-medium students of Classes VI–VIII, with a small reading library of graded readers.

programs.name: Yoga & Morning Fitness
programs.description: Twenty minutes of yoga and stretching after morning assembly, with a special session on International Yoga Day in June.

programs.name: Kabaddi Girls' Team
programs.description: Evening practice four days a week for the girls' kabaddi team, mandal champions in 2025, preparing for the district and SGF selections.

programs.name: Folk Art & Rangoli Workshop
programs.description: Local artisans teach Cheriyal-style painting and rangoli over a two-week workshop before Sankranti; student work is displayed in the school corridor.

programs.name: Water Audit Project
programs.description: Class IX students measure water use on campus, fix leaking taps with the SMC, and map rainwater harvesting options for the school and the village.

notices.title: SA-1 examination time table, Classes VI–X
notices.body: Summative Assessment 1 begins on 28 September. Students must carry their hall tickets and report by 9:15 am. The full time table is attached.

notices.title: School closed on account of heavy rain
notices.body: Following the IMD orange alert for Ranga Reddy district, the school will remain closed tomorrow. Missed classes will be made up on the second Saturday.

notices.title: Bathukamma and Dasara holidays
notices.body: The school will remain closed for Bathukamma and Dasara as per the state calendar. Classes resume on 15 October 2026.

notices.title: NMMS 2026–27: applications for Class VIII
notices.body: Eligible Class VIII students can apply for the National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship. Submit caste and income certificates to the class teacher by 10 October.

notices.title: Parent–Teacher Meeting on Saturday
notices.body: All parents are requested to attend at 10:00 am to discuss FA-2 progress and attendance. Progress cards will be shared.

notices.title: SSC March 2027: nominal roll verification
notices.body: Class X students must verify name, date of birth and photograph on the nominal roll in the office before 30 September.

notices.title: Pre-matric scholarship renewal deadline
notices.body: Students who received the pre-matric scholarship last year must renew on the ePASS portal. Bring your bank passbook and Aadhaar to the office for help.

notices.title: Second set of uniforms distributed
notices.body: Students who have not collected their second set of uniforms may do so from the office between 3:30 and 4:30 pm.

notices.title: Inter-house quiz competition results
notices.body: Congratulations to Godavari House, winners of this year's general knowledge quiz. Krishna House came second. Prizes will be given at Monday's assembly.

notices.title: FA-1 marks uploaded to the progress register
notices.body: Formative Assessment 1 marks for all classes are now entered. Parents can view them with the class teacher on any working day after 3:30 pm.
